limitations: World incident field is artist-directed, not a measured stellar corona or exact multiple-scattering atmosphere.
Native8K/128 and authoredIBL/128 must be newly rendered from this packaged scene; diagnostics are historical only.
Runtime gain2.1435469 corresponds to explicit exact encoding.25; revalidation is required for every future render.
Environment/key production calibration is reviewed separately; gallery sliders are not final gameplay evidence.

atmosphere_authoring.model: Planetless blue boundary plus one angular stellar core and a shared finite warm circumsolar incident field. No camera mask on the boundary.
atmosphere_authoring.calibration: Previous r49 panorama solar cone integrated R=14.094; its world-light multiplier .09/.10 gives ~12.685, plus legacy SUN R=9.3 gives ~21.985. New single source uses22. This is an approximate reference energy, since the previous panorama includes finite air attenuation; not exact equality at every cloud.
atmosphere_authoring.ibl_mode: Original1024x512 camera rays omit only the stellar disk. Its light and all atmospheric scattering remain active.

circumsolar_field.calibration: Actual stored f32 angular masks/axis + independently integrated field; total normal red22.

sun_energy_interpretation: Total normal red irradiance of the stellar core plus the incident circumsolar difference from B; not core alone.
original_resolution_policy: Original Cycles render at the recorded native dimensions; no resampling permitted.
